home.heroSubtitle: Universal payment system. Donations, subscriptions, purchases — one SDK.
home.featuresSectionSubtitle: Accept donations, sell products, manage subscriptions — all through a single, unified API powered by Stripe.
home.featureDonationsDesc: Accept one-time donations with testimonials, public donation walls, and customizable amounts.
home.featurePurchasesDesc: Sell products and digital items with one-time payments. Automatic receipt and fulfillment.
home.featureSubscriptionsDesc: Manage recurring billing with flexible intervals — monthly, quarterly, or yearly plans.
home.featureStripeConnectDesc: Built on Stripe for reliable, PCI-compliant payment processing worldwide.
home.featurePromoCodesDesc: Create discount codes with percentage or fixed amount off. Set expiration and usage limits.
home.featureWebhooksDesc: Real-time event notifications for payment success, failure, refund, and subscription changes.
home.howItWorksStep1Desc: Add the EZPay SDK to your project with a single command.
home.howItWorksStep2Desc: Wrap your app with PayProvider. Connect to Stripe automatically.
home.howItWorksStep3Desc: Drop in DonateModal, PurchaseButton, or SubscribeButton — ready to collect payments.
home.codeSectionSubtitle: From installation to collecting payments in under 5 minutes.
home.pricingSectionSubtitle: Pricing coming soon. EZPay is currently free during the beta period.
home.ctaSubtitle: Add donations, purchases, and subscriptions to your app in minutes. Free during beta.
